Marissa / Karthik — forwarding MediSys' asks. They want an early-termination opt-out tied to pilot metrics and a 2-step downsell protection (up to 30% for 90 days) during the ramp. They said it's blocking sign.

My read: we can probably authorize a 60-day pilot opt-out inside a 120-day ramp if they accept a partial non-refundable implementation fee, and we can offer a staged downsell protection but need a hard cap on total credits. Legal will need to confirm language.

Proposed compromise (draft language for redline):
- Pilot opt-out: Customer may terminate without penalty during the first 60 days of a designated 120-day ramp period if mutually agreed success criteria (attached) are not met; notice required in writing with 14 days' lead.
- Downsizing protection: For the 90-day transition following notice, Customer may reduce committed capacity up to 30% once; in that case Redwood will provide prorated service credits up to a maximum of 20% of the remaining committed dollar value.

Please advise if this is something Deal Desk can approve or if we need executive sign-off. If you agree, Karthik — please redline the SOW and ramp clause.

Thanks for flagging — appreciative of the clear asks from MediSys. From a commercial standpoint I can authorize a conditional exception with the following guardrails:

1) Pilot opt-out: Approve up to a 60-day opt-out inside the first 120 days, conditional on a one-time implementation fee equal to 10% of the first year ARR (non-refundable) and a mutually-agreed success criteria doc signed by both parties prior to kickoff.

2) Downsizing protection: Approve a single downsell event (up to 30%) with prorated credits capped at 20% of remaining committed value, provided the customer gives 30 days' notice and agrees to a 90-day transition cadence. No multiple downsells within the first 12 months.

3) Reporting & metrics: Customer must provide weekly pilot telemetry; Redwood reserves the right to suspend credits if abuse is detected.

I've attached a suggested redline for the ramp clause and SOW (redlines_ramp_clause.docx). Legal (Karthik) should confirm the final wording; if legal flags material risk that creates precedent we'll need a final sign-off from Revenue (Sean).

If that approach is fine I recommend we accept and update the SOW this week; Elena — we can then schedule an accelerated sign-off call.

Attachments: redlines_ramp_clause.docx

- Marissa

Looping in final approval from Rev Ops. I reviewed Marissa's proposed guardrails and Karthik's redline (thanks) — happy to approve this exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Implementation fee (10% ARR) must be invoiced and collected prior to go-live; credits or downsell relief will not be applied retroactively.
2) Credit cap: 20% of remaining committed spend (no stacking with other credits).
3) One-time downsell allowed in first 12 months only; any future capacity reductions follow standard amendment process.
4) Customer must sign the success criteria addendum and weekly telemetry access form.
5) Exception is approved for this single deal only and will be tracked as a precedent in Deal Desk artifacts.

Elena — if you confirm acceptance of the above we will send a final SOW amendment for signature today.
